about: Every colour pair the Day Dial paints that must meet WCAG 2.2 AA, in both themes: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for icons, graphics that carry meaning, control boundaries and focus indicators (SC 1.4.3, 1.4.11). fg and bg are layers, topmost first; 'token@0.5' is the token at half its opacity, 'mix(token,18)' is CSS color-mix(in srgb, token 18%, <the layer below>). A pair with per_habit expands {n} to 1-5. 'was' is what the pair painted before the 2026-11-05 contrast pass, for the before-and-after report. Checked by tools/contrast-check.py and by test/contrast_test.dart in the app.
